Family feud resolved as aunt visits nephew's home

Sunita Ahuja, aunt of actor Krishna Abhishek, visited his home to celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi, resolving a 14-year-old estrangement. She was seen touching the feet of her grandsons, Abhishek's sons, who were reportedly emotional. The visit occurred without actor Govinda, Abhishek's uncle. The reunion was marked by the family coming together to offer prayers to Lord Ganesha.
